tasks.title: QA loop audit 82: quick sale & barcode
tasks.brief: Continuous QA audit (focus: quick sale & barcode). Audit the CURRENT repo frontend locally with Playwright (desktop 1366x768 + mobile 390x844, fake data, no live writes, no supplier/live sites), focusing on the focus area plus a quick smoke of all main journeys. Every cycle must cover every main screen (البيع، الفواتير، المنتجات، العملاء، التقارير، المشتريات، الإعدادات، المحادثات، and any other top-nav tab or link). Click every top-nav link/tab and every visible primary header button (including the WhatsApp #novaWaBtn icon). Flag any HTTP 404, blank page, 'Not found', failed navigation, or console error. Read all previous .nova/qa/*report*.md first to avoid duplicates. Write .nova/qa/qa-loop-82.md (Arabic, short) with screenshots in .nova/qa/qa-loop-82/ (max 15). Then write .nova/inbox/qa-loop-82-fixes.json ({"tasks":[...]}) with at most 12 small frontend-only fix tasks (ids UX83..UX94; only high/medium findings; tests required; Black Edition Arabic RTL preserved; backend frozen; no deploy), plus, ONLY if there are fixes, a final task titled exactly 'Build worker/live/nova-rx-preview.qa-82.js (qa-loop, no deploy)' with after = all its fix ids, which rebuilds the artifact from the latest worker/live artifact the same way UX80 did (tools/build-worker-artifact.mjs, markers test, node --check, no deploy). Fix ids available: UX83, UX84, UX85, UX86, UX87, UX88, UX89, UX90, UX91, UX92, UX93, UX94. If nothing high/medium is found, write the report only (no fixes file). Do not edit .nova/cloud-queue.json.
tasks.acceptance: Report .nova/qa/qa-loop-82.md exists; fixes inbox file only if high/medium findings; no deploy; backend untouched.
